description: Navigable Water Regulation Areas (DOT-005) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport. Navigable Water Regulation Areas including Closed Waters, Speed Restriction Areas, Water Ski Areas, Jet Ski Areas, Swimming Prohibited Areas. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport. Its tags are areas, department of transport, navigable, regulation, water. It offers 6 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
